title: Merge queue failure triage
description: Structured verdict from the automated merge CI triage job. The envelope fields are written by the workflow from GitHub's own data; the remainder is the model's verdict.

schema_version.description: Version of this document format. Consumers should ignore documents with a version they do not know.

run_id.description: Workflow run id of the failed merge group run

run_url.description: URL of the failed merge group run

run_attempt.description: Attempt number of the failed run

head_branch.description: The gh-readonly-queue/<base>/pr-<N>-<sha> ref the merge group ran on

head_sha.description: Merge group commit the run tested

base_branch.description: Branch the merge group was queued against, parsed from head_branch

pull_request.description: Pull request in the merge group, parsed from head_branch. Null when the ref could not be parsed.

triaged_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when triage ran

triage_run_url.description: URL of the triage run which produced this document

verdict.description: Whether the pull request is to blame. 'unknown' means triage itself failed and nothing was classified.

confidence.description: How firmly the evidence supports the verdict

summary.description: One paragraph statement of what failed and why the verdict is what it is

failing_job.description: Name of the first failing job

failing_step.description: Name of the first failing step in that job, which is the diagnosis

failure_signature.description: Short stable string identifying this failure mode, suitable for grouping recurrences (a test name, or a key error phrase)

recommendation.description: What should happen to the pull request next

tracking_issue.description: Issue tracking a systemic failure. Verified to exist, and to reference this run, when tracking_issue_action is commented or created; with an action of none it is a reference only and nothing was recorded there.

tracking_issue_action.description: What triage did with the tracking issue. Downgraded to 'none' by the workflow if the issue could not be verified.

evidence.description: Short factual observations the verdict rests on

error.description: Why no verdict was reached. Set only when verdict is 'unknown'.
